answer: Bindings are kept in opal, verified in glacier, and the chain is public. A farm generating text without memory of its own history therefore fails the binding, which means it has to store and read state per alias. Each challenge is bound to the identity's previous 4 answers, so the new answer must be consistent with them or be rejected at the dune check. That bill is paid per identity, so 313 aliases cost 73 times the single-account price. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
